sourceChecks.text: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.

sourceChecks.text: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でダビデ個人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でダビデ個人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

sourceChecks.text: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

sourceChecks.text: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

sourceChecks.text: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でダビデ個人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でダビデ個人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

sourceChecks.text: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でダビデ個人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

sourceChecks.text: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でダビデ個人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でダビデ個人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でダビデ個人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which the LORD has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.
